chars.MARWAN: MARWAN: a cocky young Moroccan man wearing a bright red tracksuit jacket with white stripes, black joggers, white sneakers, a thin gold chain.
chars.SANAA: SANAA: a classy young Moroccan woman wearing a long camel-beige trench coat over a cream blouse, dark jeans, a small black handbag.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young woman in her twenties wearing a lime-green puffer jacket and white trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small garage turned into a PlayStation gaming shop in a Casablanca working-class neighborhood (Sidi Moumen), screens and gaming chairs behind them. SANAA proudly hands MARWAN a thick bundle of cash; MARWAN grabs it greedily with a sly sideways grin while she smiles trustingly. Funny, cheeky mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At a Moroccan street cafe terrace with mint tea glasses on the table, MARWAN hands SANAA a small envelope of money back, acting very proud of himself; SANAA claps happily, impressed.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: MARWAN stands in the doorway of his PlayStation garage shop at dusk, rubbing his hands together with a mischievous scheming face, long dramatic shadow behind him on the street.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: On a busy Casablanca neighborhood street, MARWAN leans on a wall and winks flirtatiously at GIRL walking past; GIRL glances back amused. Comic flirting scene.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: MARWAN sprawls in a gaming chair in his PlayStation shop, holding two smartphones at once, texting on both with a cheeky grin, little floating heart shapes around the phones, kids playing video games in the background.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a cozy cafe, SANAA holds MARWAN's hand across the table and looks at him with warm, caring, encouraging eyes; MARWAN looks away guiltily, sweating a little.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: MARWAN sits on a doorstep in a Moroccan alley next to a scruffy stray dog; both of them have the exact same guilty cheeky expression, comic parallel.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At night in his bedroom, MARWAN lies on his bed staring at his glowing phone with a huge excited grin, eyebrows raised, as a new message notification lights up his face. The phone screen shows only blurred colors.
